title: CLI tests for rcf define readiness
description: Covers AC-17501-5 (text output, --json emission, --check exit codes), AC-17502-7 (byte-stable rcf/ tree across a readiness run) and AC-17503-1..9 (default exits 0 + both verdict lines; --level intent exits 4 iff PO fails; --level build exits 4 iff readyToBuild is false, with warn lines emitted; --check all unchanged; --persona filters text and does not change exit; unknown values exit 2; --json --level intent carries _meta.level; text report groups PO before engineer with persona in detail lines; parameterised exit matrix).
